settings.heading: Why order here
settings.text: A gang sheet puts many designs on one strip of film, so you print more for less. Build yours online in minutes.

settings.title: Build it yourself
settings.text: Upload, resize and arrange your designs, or let Auto arrange pack them tightly for you.

settings.title: Sharp 300 DPI prints
settings.text: Every sheet prints at 300 DPI. The builder warns you if an image is too low quality.

settings.title: Pay by the foot
settings.text: No fixed sizes required. The more feet you order, the lower the price per foot.

settings.heading: Made for shops, teams and makers
settings.text: Whether you run a custom apparel business, print for a school or team, or make one-off shirts, gang sheets let you print many designs at once and save.

settings.title: Free local pickup
settings.text: Pick up at 10920 Hull Street Rd, Midlothian, VA. Usually ready in 2-4 days.

settings.title: UPS shipping
settings.text: Ship anywhere with UPS Standard or Express. Sheets are rolled and packed in a sturdy box.

settings.heading: Ordered with us before?
settings.text: Original customers get special pricing. Enter your code in the builder to apply it.

settings.heading: Ready to print?
settings.text: Your designs, your sheet, printed sharp and ready to press.
